READ THIS OR YOU WILL BE BANNED PERMANENTLY.

If your PR is LLM generated and you have not done the work of testing
on new models or analyzing the design decisions behind the PR, you
will be banned with no further warnings.

**BEFORE YOU START**: please make sure your pull request is against the `dev` branch.
We cannot accept pull requests against the `main` branch.
See our [contributing guide](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/stanza/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.

IF YOU THINK YOU FOUND A USE FOR AN LLM GENERATED PR:

First, you didn't, please go away.

Second, in the unlikely event that point 1 is actually wrong, the
minimum effort you can put in is to open a new issue or discuss on an
existing open issue what you think can be contributed with the agent.

Please understand: if an issue is open and it looks easy to solve with
an LLM, there is a reason it hasn't yet been solved with an LLM.

## Description
A brief and concise description of what your pull request is trying to accomplish.

## Fixes Issues
A list of issues/bugs with # references. (e.g., #123)

## Unit test coverage
Are there unit tests in place to make sure your code is functioning correctly?
(see [here](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/stanza/blob/master/tests/test_tagger.py) for a simple example)

## Known breaking changes/behaviors
Does this break anything in Stanza's existing user interface? If so, what is it and how is it addressed?
